lines.x: The Israeli shekel continued to decline on Thursday, with the US dollar rising past 3.30 shekels and the euro surging to a one-year peak of 3.62 shekels.
ZIM reported a 53% increase in third-quarter revenues to $2.71 billion and a 573% surge in net income to $830 million.
ZIM Integrated Shipping Services announced a net income of $830 million for the third quarter of 2026, driven by favorable market conditions and strategic execution.
Amazon is nearing an agreement to acquire Israeli artificial intelligence company Decart for more than $7 billion, with talks led by Amazon's Israeli VP Nafea Bshara.
